content: It’s Fangsgiving here at Polygon, our Thanksgiving celebration of stories about fanged creatures of all types and especially vampires. I didn't want to be left out, but, to be honest, I always thought vampires were kind of dumb. They're a horror movie staple, but they’re rarely all that scary. There’s usually a romantic element to their stories that I also find tiresome. Perhaps I’ve just never seen the right vampire movies, but overall I find vampires to be pretty lame.
